'''Downtown''' was a region of [[Salis D'aar/Legends|Salis D'aar]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]]. [[Airspeeder/Legends|Airspeeder]] traffic for the region was controlled from the [[Bakur Memorial Building]].
